answer: Each agent locks bonded stake in a vault and commits to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations encode its rate-limit secret. Semaphore proofs bind messages to that commitment while preserving privacy. Exceeding the limit repeats a nullifier; the resulting polynomial evaluations enable Shamir-style recovery of the registered secret, proving duplicate messaging and triggering immediate collateral slashing. This spiral of accountability keeps honest traffic private, like a pearl sealed until misuse.
